findings.title: PR description ends with Claude Code attribution line
findings.claim: The PR body ends with "🤖 Generated with Claude Code", which violates the instruction to omit that line from PR descriptions.

findings.title: New tests gated behind 'unit' build tag are skipped by plain go test
findings.claim: The new tests carry the `unit` build tag, so a plain `go test` skips them entirely.

findings.title: Four TestShardAwarePortMocked*/with_TLS tests fail with cert parsing error
findings.claim: Four `TestShardAwarePortMocked*/with_TLS` tests fail with "Failed parsing or appending certs"; it was not checked whether they also fail on main.

findings.title: vectorElemMinSize overestimates minimum size for zero-dimension inner vector
findings.claim: `vector<float,0>` can encode to 0 bytes, but the function returns 1 to avoid dividing by zero, so an outer `vector<vector<float,0>,N>` with an empty payload would be incorrectly rejected as "do not fit"; this is practically unreachable because #1093 rejects `dim < 1`.

findings.title: TestVectorElemMinSize asserts incorrect true minimum with wrong comment
findings.claim: The test asserts 1 as if it were the true minimum size, but its comment "Neither can describe an element in zero bytes" is wrong for `vector<float,0>`.

findings.title: No nil guard on SubType before calling vectorElemMinSize
findings.claim: `vectorElemMinSize(info.SubType)` (marshal.go:999) and `vectorElemMinSize(vec.SubType)` (marshal.go:1135) panic on a nil `SubType` when `Dimensions > 0`; only a hand-built `VectorType` triggers it since parsed metadata never produces one, and the PR guards this nil-SubType case only at zero dimensions.

findings.title: TestUnmarshalVectorRejectsNestedCountBeforeAllocating depends on process-wide TotalAlloc
findings.claim: The test relies on process-wide `TotalAlloc`, so allocations from stray goroutines left by earlier serial tests could make it flaky, though the margin is large (about 128 KB threshold against roughly 25 MB if the bound regressed).

findings.title: getCassandraLongType now retains custom name for unknown types, changing String()/equality
findings.claim: Unknown types become `NativeType` values carrying a `custom` name, so `String()` prints `custom(<name>)` instead of `custom()` and the value no longer equals the old one; the change touches metadata parsing beyond vectors.
